branches.measured_bottleneck: The supervised pointer label selected the ABI state immediately before the matched source token. Because hidden state t predicts token t+1, the observed source token is first represented one causal state later. Starting copy_alpha at zero also made the language-loss gradient into copy_value vanish; the saved best-loss checkpoint left the copy path effectively inactive.
branches.next_bounded_change: Shift lexical pointer labels to the post-token ABI state and explicitly train the copy-value projection to reconstruct the matched token through the unchanged frozen tied head. Continue the same checkpoint, data, capacity, and validation suite.

branches.measured_bottleneck: The post-token alignment repair learned its training objectives, but a single global signed mixture remained inactive because copying is useful only on selected response units. Soft pointer averaging further blended source states, and value supervision limited to repeated response tokens reconstructed only 52.0% of unseen identifier units even at the true source state.
branches.next_bounded_change: Use one supervised per-unit copy gate, straight-through hard top-1 lexical routing, and prompt-wide post-token lexical conformance on the same data and capacity lineage. This adds only a 769-parameter gate and makes the active copy read physically sparse.

branches.measured_bottleneck: Generic repeated-token pointer labels are ambiguous inside multi-token identifiers, and the gate activates for every repeated response token rather than only the requested function-name span. branches.next_bounded_change: Return to the preserved 48/64 semantic checkpoint. Supervise only the exact monotonic function-identifier span and decode each selected source token from the consecutive pre/post-token ABI-state transition. Keep inference as one hard gathered state pair.

branches.measured_bottleneck: Exact monotonic training labels repaired the label definition and recovered semantic behavior from 23/64 to 42/64 name-agnostic successes, but the learned semantic pointer and transition projection did not generalize to unseen identifier lexemes. Under teacher forcing, the pointer selected only 40.9% of exact held-out source positions and the true source transition decoded only 58.3% of held-out identifier units. A prohibited diagnostic header rewrite reached only 45/64, so lexical copying is not the sole remaining quality defect.
branches.next_bounded_change: Separate host-level lexical conformance from Python semantics: train the same canonical-ABI pointer/value path on a preregistered tokenizer-vocabulary coverage corpus with no promotion credit, then attach it to the preserved 48/64 semantic parent and add bounded generated-prefix recovery only if lexical conformance passes its held-out probe.

implementation_failure_before_training.repair: serialize contiguous NumPy bytes for tensors of every rank

branches.next_bounded_change: Reject cached position-aligned on-policy correction and return to the preserved semantic parent. Any next lexical repair must preserve the token-embedding manifold and any future recovery method must align sequences rather than assume generated and gold prefixes remain positionally equivalent.
